decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the J_DISP_LED population and DNP instructions relevant to the assembly-ready BOM; no edit or additional Event is needed.
The source specifies a separate external e-paper backlight on J_DISP_LED, not the SK6812 addressable LED supply or data interface.
The BSS138 PWM switch controls the separate display backlight and does not change the addressable LED board's standby power-switching topology.
The J_DISP_LED backlight circuit does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, sensor pinouts, or sensor supply interfaces.
The source concerns a non-addressable external e-paper backlight and does not alter the separate eight-SK6812 indicator board.
The current backlight build uses 5V and merely retains an unpopulated 3.3V fallback footprint; it does not change DCDC1's configured or target rail voltage.
Specifying the backlight load does not change which rails must be monitored or the monitoring topology; the source does not establish any new metering requirement.
The source specifies a dedicated low-side PWM switch for J_DISP_LED and does not place the backlight on, or modify, the independently switched 5V sensor rail.
The unpopulated 3.3V backlight fallback does not change the current standalone USB regulator, its activation condition, or its required load capacity.
The BSS138 in the source is a display-backlight power switch, not a sensor logic-level shifter, so the sensor-interface requirement remains unchanged.
Keeping the backlight off during boot through a MOSFET gate pull-down does not modify the ESP32 BOOT button or reset circuit.
The DNP series-resistor footprint belongs to the LED backlight power path and does not affect I2C pull-ups or signal-conditioning resistors.
